content.title: About
content.content: Soy chips are crunchy snacks made from whole soybeans that are roasted or baked until golden. They have a mild nutty flavor and are often seasoned with salt, spices, or soy sauce.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Soy chips contain more protein than most traditional potato chips.
The production uses whole soy protein and is gluten‑free.
Soybeans are one of the oldest cultivated crops, grown by humans for over 5,000 years.
Baked versions are less fatty than deep‑fried chips.
A wide range of flavors exists: barbecue, spicy chili, sea salt, and more.

items.title: Rich in plant protein
items.content: A single serving of soy chips provides about 15 % of the daily recommended protein, beneficial for vegetarians and athletes.

items.title: Contains isoflavones
items.content: Soy isoflavones have antioxidant properties and may support hormonal balance.

items.title: Low in saturated fat
items.content: Compared with conventional chips, soy chips contain mainly polyunsaturated fatty acids.

items.title: Source of dietary fiber
items.content: Fiber aids digestion and promotes satiety.

items.title: B‑vitamins
items.content: Soybeans are a good source of vitamin B6 and folate, important for metabolism.

items.title: Soy allergy
items.content: Some individuals may experience allergic reactions to soy, ranging from mild to anaphylaxis.

items.title: Sodium content
items.content: Salted varieties can be high in sodium, which is a concern for people with hypertension.

items.title: Phytates
items.content: Soybeans contain phytates that may reduce mineral absorption when consumed in excess.

items.title: Genetically modified organisms (GMOs)
items.content: Most soy crops are GMO; those avoiding GMOs should look for certified non‑GMO products.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Soy chips are convenient as a standalone snack, tossed into salads, soups, or used as a crunchy topping for Asian‑style dishes. Choose versions without artificial flavorings for a cleaner snack.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store soy chips in an airtight container in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. Once opened, consume within 2–3 weeks to maintain crispness and flavor.
